name: devcontext-monorepo
description: Sync development data locally to give people and AI complete project context.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @devcontext/web && npm run build --workspace @devcontext/cli
scripts.test:e2e:viewer: npm run build && npm run e2e --workspace @devcontext/e2e
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run build && npm run e2e:update --workspace @devcontext/e2e
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.tui: npm run build:cli && npm run build --workspace @devcontext/tui && npm run start --workspace @devcontext/tui
